stories.title: Critical Cisco Nexus 9000 Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Remote Attackers Run Code as Root
stories.description: Cisco patches a Nexus 9000 flaw enabling unauthenticated remote root code execution and seven IOS XR umbrella CVEs affecting every release.

stories.title: Manchester Airports Group Data on 8.8 Million People Leaked After Ransom Refusal
stories.description: Hacker group published roughly 550GB of data after MAG reportedly refused to pay a ransom demand; the group says it gained access via exposed admin keys.

stories.title: BraZetsu Malware Turns Compromised Windows Hosts Into Criminal Marketplace Inventory
stories.description: BraZetsu profiles compromised Windows hosts, collects browser and financial data, and stocks the Infected Marketplace.

stories.title: Capsule Security Launches ‘AI Circuit Breaker’ to Stop Rogue Agents
stories.description: New models, trained using NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, aim to catch rogue agent behavior before it executes, without the latency of large-model review.

stories.title: OpenAI Investigates Elevated Errors Affecting ChatGPT and Codex Services
stories.description: OpenAI has reported an ongoing service incident involving elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex, with the company confirming that it is investigating degraded performance affecting the two platforms.

stories.title: Phantom Deal Hackers Impersonate Executives and Use Fake NDAs to Steal Corporate Wire Transfers
stories.description: Phantom Deal uses fake executive WhatsApp messages to trick employees into sending large wire transfers without malware.

stories.title: Hackers Weaponize ScreenConnect to Spread Worm-Like Malware Across Windows Systems
stories.description: Rogue remote-support clients spread malware across Windows systems, using social engineering and trusted tools to expand attacks.

stories.title: Chaotic Eclipse Claims Avast Antivirus 0-Day Vulnerability – PoC Released
stories.description: Chaotic Eclipse claims an Avast Antivirus zero-day privilege-escalation flaw and released the PrettyPrague PoC.

stories.title: Thomson Reuters Court Software Breach May Have Exposed SSNs and Sealed Data
stories.description: Thomson Reuters says an unauthorized party obtained C-Track court files that may contain personal and sealed information.

stories.title: HiddenLayer Raises $100 Million for AI Runtime Security
stories.description: The Austin-based company will invest in agentic runtime security capabilities to secure AI coding agents.

stories.title: AI Agent Firewall Startup AIR Security Emerges From Stealth With $50 Million
stories.description: The startup’s firewall evaluates AI skills, plugins and MCP servers for malicious instructions, excessive permissions and software supply chain risks.

stories.title: US Becomes Top Target in RMM Phishing Campaign Spanning 46 Countries
stories.description: A phishing campaign uses fake documents to install legitimate RMM software across 46 countries, with 45% of activity tied to the U.S.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
